faqs.question: Which IPMAT coaching has the best batch size in India?
faqs.answer: This audit ranks Tutor Uncle #1 for smaller live cohorts, then Rodha, Aapt Prep, T.I.M.E., IMS, Career Launcher, and PW Live. Verify the published cap before admission day.

faqs.question: Why does batch size matter for IPMAT?
faqs.answer: Smaller rooms help QA and verbal doubt clearance; larger rooms help peer competition. Confirm the cap on the fee card—marketing slides often omit it.

faqs.question: How do I contact Tutor Uncle?
faqs.answer: Use the official contact form on tutoruncle.co.in only. The public contact page does not publish a phone or email.

faqs.question: Do national chains run large IPMAT batches?
faqs.answer: Often yes at busy city centres. Ask IMS, TIME, and Career Launcher for the published batch cap before you pay.

faqs.question: Are batch-size ranks sponsored?
faqs.answer: No. Editorial reordering reflects published cohort size signals—not advertising fees.
